_comment: Wan VACE 1.3B — Animate-Anything workflow. Takes a reference image and generates an animated clip of it with motion. REQUIREMENTS: Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors in diffusion_models/, Wan2.1_VAE.pth in vae/ (via wan_vaes secondary path in extra_model_paths.yaml), models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth in text_encoders/ (symlinked from Wan model dir). Validated with ComfyUI 0.34.0 + ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper.

1._comment: Loads Wan VACE 1.3B DiT model. Use main_device on A100 (40GB). Use offload_device on smaller cards.

2._comment: Wan VAE. Requires precision='bf16' explicitly even though optional (bug in node). Found via wan_vaes secondary path in extra_model_paths.yaml.

3._comment: Wan T5 encoder. Symlinked from video/Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B/ into local text_encoders/ so it appears in the dropdown.

4._comment: Text encode. t5 input required — must be wired from LoadWanVideoT5TextEncoder (not auto-loaded from model).

inputs.positive_prompt: a fantasy warrior woman in silver armor, slow cinematic camera pan, mist swirling, leaves falling, dramatic atmospheric lighting, cinematic
inputs.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, deformed, static, ugly

5._comment: Reference image. Place in ComfyUI input/ folder before running.

6._comment: VACE conditioning. ref_images drives animate-anything mode — generates motion from a static reference. num_frames=49 = ~3s at 16fps. Increase for longer clips.

7._comment: Sampling. steps=20, scheduler=unipc is the recommended baseline. shift=8.0 works well for VACE. force_offload=false on A100 for speed.

8._comment: Decode latents to frames. enable_vae_tiling helps with VRAM on longer clips.

9._comment: Save to MP4. Match frame_rate to the prompt (VACE generates at ~16fps for 1.3B).
